name: Kisslinger Kristallglas Rattenberg
kurzbeschreibung: The Kisslinger Kristallglas show glassworks in Rattenberg: centuries-old glassblowing craftsmanship, grinding, engraving, and sparkling glass art.
beschreibung:
Overview

The traditional show glassworks Kisslinger Kristallglas is located in the medieval center of Austria's smallest town, the glass town of Rattenberg in Tyrol's Lower Inn Valley (Kufstein district) at an altitude of around 521 meters. Situated directly in the historic pedestrian zone at Südtiroler Straße 30, this family-run traditional company symbolizes centuries of Tyrolean glassmaking art. Across more than 1,000 square meters of exhibition and sales space, visitors experience the entire creation process of exquisite crystal glass – from the glowing furnace to the artfully refined masterpiece. The fascinating world of glass is brought to life and made tangible here.

Route & Requirements

A visit to the Kisslinger Kristallglas show glassworks is suitable for all age groups and fitness levels. The show workshops and the crystal gallery are located on the ground floor and are barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible. Visitors can move freely through the different areas and watch the glassblowers, grinders, and engravers at work. There are no fixed routes, so you can customize the duration of your stay. Glassblowing demonstrations take place at regular intervals and are a highlight of the visit. The environment is warm due to the furnaces, but generally comfortable.

Visit & Arrival

The show glassworks and exhibition rooms of Kisslinger Kristallglas are open year-round from Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 (Sundays from May to October from 10:00 to 17:00; glassblowing demonstrations Monday to Friday all day). Admission to the show workshops is free! Guided tours for groups are offered by prior arrangement. Arrival by car: Via the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Kramsach/Brixlegg), then on the B171 to Rattenberg; paid parking is available directly in front of the city gates (East or West car park) (the city center is car-free). By public transport: Train (ÖBB/S-Bahn) to Rattenberg-Kramsach station, from there it's just a two-minute walk through the historic city gate directly to the show glassworks.

Tips

The show workshops and the crystal gallery on the ground floor are barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible. Particularly brave visitors can, by prior arrangement and under the expert guidance of the master glassblower, blow their own glass ball and take it home as a personal souvenir. Combine your visit with a stroll through Rattenberg's colorful pedestrian zone or a climb to the Schlossberg ruins to explore the picturesque surroundings. Pay attention to the detailed engravings and cuts that demonstrate the high artistry of the glassmakers. A visit to Kisslinger Kristallglas is a wonderful opportunity to experience a traditional craft up close and find unique souvenirs.
preis: Admission free; guided tours on request
